hook.text: Every car—even an EV—has a small 12-volt battery under the hood. It runs nearly everything you touch.

buildup.text: Lights, wipers, radio, power windows, and the computer that starts your engine all use 12 volts.

discovery.text: In gas cars, the alternator charges this battery while driving, using a belt connected to the engine.

twist.text: In EVs, a DC-DC converter steps down the high-voltage battery to keep the 12-volt system alive.

climax.text: If the 12-volt battery dies, even a fully charged EV won't start—it can't wake up its own computers.

punchline.text: The smallest battery in the car is also the most critical.

quiz.question: What happens if an EV's 12-volt battery dies?
options: Nothing, the main battery takes over
